acceptance_reason: Hull edit commits exactly once; every derived property either matches the current hull revision or is explicitly stale/quarantined; old results cannot replace current vessel state.

definition.fail_criteria: Provider/physics result rewrites hull truth, mixed revisions are treated as current, or hull elements duplicate/disappear.
definition.inconclusive_conditions: Vessel is stationary or hull is not genuinely editable during the tested run.
invalidation_conditions: Evidence is unusable due to wrong build/configuration, measurement defect or contamination.
A proof run without adequate exact build identity may be INVALIDATED.
definition.pass_criteria: Hull edit commits exactly once; every derived property either matches the current hull revision or is explicitly stale/quarantined; old results cannot replace current vessel state.
procedure: Commit vessel-local hull edits while the vessel moves.
Delay mass, collision, buoyancy and flooding projections and inject pre-edit results.
Publish only projections naming the current hull/fluid revisions.
definition.question: Can a vessel hull be edited while underway without producing stale mass, collision, buoyancy, flooding or structural state that becomes authoritative?
definition.required_repetition: Thousands of edits under varied speed/rotation/water exposure with randomized derived delays.
definition.title: Vessel Hull Edit Underway

observations: Canonical hull revisions advanced before mass, collision, buoyancy, flooding and structure projections.
